items.title: Luther Henderson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Well, briefly Schilinger, Joseph Schilinger, I believe his first name was Joseph

ctx.x: The Schilinger System? Gosh, you ask some long-winded questions, I tell you. Well, briefly Schilinger, Joseph Schilinger, I believe his first name was Joseph, was

a mathematician who had a theory, which he went forth to prove, that the growth patterns, any creative effort, any creative endeavor, any creative evidence could be measured, synthesized and analyzed and synthesized according to a discernible mathematical formula. Meaning that in our quest to know why things come out the way they do, why is music this way and so forth, that he would have the answer to how you could do that. If you learned that, then you could learn and write any type of music that you wanted to,…
